user.title: House Chime
user.description: Create the announcement control integration. House Chime discovers Home Assistant people, playback zones, and approved media paths, then plays announcements through Music Assistant.

data_description.name: The display name for this House Chime installation.

missing_media.title: Announcement media is missing
missing_media.description: House Chime could not find a configured media asset for `{event_id}`. Check the configured media path in House Chime options and confirm the file exists in Home Assistant local media. Error: `{error}`

no_target_zones.title: No announcement zones are selected
no_target_zones.description: House Chime resolved `{event_id}`, but no playable target zones remained after selected-zone and quiet-zone rules were applied. Select at least one available playback zone in House Chime options. Error: `{error}`

missing_music_assistant_service.title: Music Assistant announcement service is missing
missing_music_assistant_service.description: House Chime requires `music_assistant.play_announcement` for playback. Install or enable Music Assistant before using House Chime playback services. Error: `{error}`

incompatible_playback_targets.title: Selected speakers cannot play Music Assistant announcements
incompatible_playback_targets.description: House Chime resolved `{event_id}`, but one or more selected speaker targets are missing or cannot use `music_assistant.play_announcement`. Music Assistant or Home Assistant may have recreated a `media_player` entity after an update, restore, or device rediscovery. Open House Chime options and reselect the current Music Assistant announcement-capable speakers. The issue clears after this event resolves cleanly. Error: `{error}`

playback_url_signing_failed.title: Announcement audio URL could not be signed
playback_url_signing_failed.description: House Chime could not create the temporary signed Home Assistant Local Media URL needed for `{event_id}`. Update House Chime and Home Assistant, then try again. Error: `{error}`

playback_url_unreachable.title: Announcement audio URL is not reachable
playback_url_unreachable.description: House Chime resolved `{event_id}`, but the playback URL could not be fetched before sending it to Music Assistant. Check that the media file is in Home Assistant Local Media and that House Chime is up to date. Error: `{error}`

init.title: House Chime setup
init.description: Configure household context, announcement behaviour, playback, and operating rules.

household.title: Household
household.description: Manage presence, context priority, and each person's shared-announcement preference.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: Configure event behaviour, approved voice audio, and personalisation.

rules.title: Rules & diagnostics
rules.description: Control door-aware suppression and review the effective setup without playing audio.

people.title: Household people
people.description: Select the Home Assistant people House Chime should use. Any discovered person can be configured; no household names are built into House Chime. Discovered people: {person_count}.

data_description.selected_people: Only selected people are considered for presence, personalisation, and shared-speaker playback preferences.

preferences.title: Playback preferences
preferences.description: Choose a household person to control whether shared announcements play while they are home.

data_description.playback_enabled_when_home: When all people currently home have this turned off, House Chime intentionally suppresses playback. A disabled person does not silence another enabled person.

personalisation.title: Personalisation
personalisation.description: Choose a person and event to set their optional voice and pre-sound override.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Rank selected people. The first enabled person who is home supplies personalisation for shared playback.

data_description.priority_people: Choose people in the order House Chime should prefer when more than one enabled person is home.
data_description.default_context_id: Used when none of the selected people are home.

zones.title: Speakers

playback.title: Playback
playback.description: Choose speakers, set daytime levels, adjust individual rooms, and configure bedtime playback.

volume.title: Daytime announcement volume
volume.description: This is the normal level outside bedtime. {quiet_preview}

data_description.normal_volume: The shared announcement level used before a selected speaker's individual adjustment.

zone_levels.title: Speaker announcement levels
zone_levels.description: Choose one of the {selected_count} selected announcement speakers to adjust. A speaker at 100 percent uses the daytime level unchanged.

data_description.volume_multiplier: Relative to the shared daytime announcement volume. Use 100 percent for no adjustment.

media.title: Voice audio
media.description: Choose an event, then select its approved announcement file for each voice.

event_media.title: Voice audio
event_media.description: Select the approved {event_name} announcement file for each voice. Upload files through Home Assistant Media / Local Media first.

events.title: Events
events.description: Choose one announcement event to configure.

event_front_door_approach.title: Approach
event_front_door_approach.description: Configure the shared default for Approach. Per-person overrides are in Personalisation.

data_description.duplicate_window_seconds: Ignore repeated Approach detections for this many seconds.

event_front_door_package.title: Package
event_front_door_package.description: Configure the shared default for Package. Per-person overrides are in Personalisation.

data_description.duplicate_window_seconds: Ignore repeated Package detections for this many seconds.

event_front_door_doorbell.title: Doorbell
event_front_door_doorbell.description: Configure the shared default for Doorbell. Per-person overrides are in Personalisation.

data_description.duplicate_window_seconds: Ignore repeated Doorbell events for this many seconds.

quiet.title: Bedtime / quiet hours
quiet.description: Configure when announcements become quieter or skip selected speakers. {effective_preview}

data_description.volume_multiplier: Volume multiplier during quiet hours. 0.5 means 50 percent of the normal announcement volume.
data_description.quiet_excluded_zones: These selected announcement speakers do not play while the speaker exclusion window is active.
data_description.zone_start: Leave blank to use the bedtime start time.
data_description.zone_end: Leave blank to use the bedtime end time.

door_guard.title: Door-aware approach suppression
door_guard.description: Approach announcements are dropped while this sensor is open and for the configured time after it opens. Doorbell and package announcements continue.

data_description.sensor_entity_id: Leave unselected to disable this rule. The binary sensor must report on while the door is open.
data_description.cooldown_seconds: Seconds to suppress Approach after each closed-to-open transition. Use 0 to suppress only while the door is open.

review.title: Review / Dry Run
